content.short: Wake is an open-source, Python-based framework developed by Ackee Blockchain Security.
content.description: Wake is a toolkit for Solidity development, testing, and security analysis. It supports deployment and testing across Ethereum, Polygon, OP Mainnet, and Solana, ranging from basic unit tests to advanced fuzzing with chain forking to enable thorough integration testing. It offers static analysis through detectors that identify vulnerabilities and printers that extract key information, and it integrates with Visual Studio Code via the Tools for Solidity extension.
